description: Lancashire Police and Crime Commissioner is a police and crime commissioner. Accrual-coded expenditure categories bucket to accrual_journal. Pension contributions bucket to internal_transfer. Otherwise procurement_paid.

rules.reason: Month-end accrual bookings in the finance ledger. Reverse when invoices clear — summing with paid invoices double-counts.
Lancashire Police Pension Fund is the council's own pensions vehicle — money from the general fund to the pension fund is an internal transfer, not third-party procurement.
